base_probability_role: deterministic synthetic Dirichlet stress probabilities; no outcome labels read
failure: The original unscaled L-BFGS dual reached the 500-iteration limit and raised RuntimeError: STOP: TOTAL NO. OF ITERATIONS REACHED LIMIT.
root_cause: Constraint/state coordinates have sharply different curvature because group sizes and rare-state variances vary by orders of magnitude; the mathematically valid but unscaled dual is poorly conditioned for a real flight day.
adjudication: The next implementation uses an exact diagonal reparameterization based on the square root of the dual Hessian diagonal at the base forecast. The objective and estimand are unchanged.
